name: Two users type on the same line at once

steps.expected: Workbench loads and the status pill shows Saved

steps.action: Editor opens the invite link and signs in
steps.expected: Editor lands in the same Workbench with Saved showing

steps.action: Both open Files and select index.html
steps.expected: The code editor shows index.html for both users

steps.action: Both put the cursor at the end of the same line and type at the same moment (Owner: <!-- Alex edited -->, Editor: <!-- Morgan edited -->)
steps.expected: Both see Saving, then Saved, with no error
steps.actual: Both returned to Saved; 0 error banners

steps.action: Compare the text in both editors
steps.expected: Both texts appear exactly once, in the same order, for both users
steps.actual: Identical in both editors; each line once; Alex's line first

steps.action: Editor reloads the page and opens index.html again
steps.expected: Both texts are still there after the reload
steps.actual: After reload: Alex line ×1, Morgan line ×1

steps.action: Check post-condition 1 (read the draft from the server)
steps.expected: The stored draft contains both lines exactly once
